I posted the draft in #strategic-random as a reply to your message. Everything in it comes from #inc-vtg-hartford, which you are a member of.

- First report: 10:42 AM, gate kiosks offline and both inbound lanes showing a white screen.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM, when trailer 8836 was checked in.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM (Gideon's update was posted at 11:08).

The incident room dates these messages 3 Aug 2026, so the draft uses that date. Today's date is 14 Oct, so tell me if the summary should carry a different date. The draft also notes that the status-page access issue for Mateo's login is still open under INC-4821.
